description: Gives the price, recipient and chain find_budget_services lists for one of its services, and when that price was last checked. With agent, also says whether what is left of that agent's budget covers it. This is the listed price, not a live one: the Superstables CLI's budget buy reads the seller's live price and recipient, and checks them, before it pays. Any other URL is refused. Doesn't contact the seller, sign transactions or move funds.

agent.description: The id of an agent from list_my_budgets; its chain is the one checked

chain.description: A chain key, when the URL is listed on more than one chain

url.description: A service URL exactly as find_budget_services lists it

name: preflight_budget_purchase
title: Check a budget purchase's price
